title: Frontend Development
shortDesc: Interfaces, interactions and performant web experiences.
description: We build pixel-perfect, blazing-fast web interfaces using React and Next.js. From single-page apps to complex multi-step workflows, we craft every interaction with care — ensuring speed, accessibility, and cross-device consistency.

title: UI / UX Design
shortDesc: Interfaces that are clear, intentional and enjoyable to use.
description: Great software begins with intentional design. We research, prototype, and iterate until we've found the simplest, most elegant solution to every design problem — then we make it beautiful.

title: Backend Development
shortDesc: Reliable APIs, business logic and scalable systems.
description: We architect and build the systems that power your product — REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication, databases, third-party integrations, and the infrastructure that keeps everything running reliably.

title: Quality Assurance
shortDesc: Testing, debugging and reliability throughout development.
description: Quality is not an afterthought at Quanta — it's baked into every sprint. Our QA process covers automated testing, performance benchmarking, cross-browser validation, and end-to-end scenario testing before anything ships.

title: Deployment & DevOps
shortDesc: Production builds, deployment pipelines and launch support.
description: We don't just hand over code — we launch your product and make sure it stays healthy. From CI/CD pipeline setup to production monitoring, we handle the full deployment lifecycle.
